                                                                                                    KEC International Limited                          KEC at a Glance




KEC at a Glance

We transform lives by building
sustainable world class infrastructure.

KEC International Limited, the flagship
company of the RPG Group, is a global
infrastructure Engineering, Procurement and
Construction (EPC) major. From our origins
in power transmission, we have grown into a
diversified enterprise spanning six businesses
across more than 110 countries, building the
grids, cities, pipelines, railway infrastructure
and clean-energy systems on which
modern life depends.

The operating environment has become
increasingly complex. Projects are larger,
timelines tighter, geographies more demanding
and stakeholders more exacting. In this
environment, scale and experience alone no
longer determine success; what sets an
organisation apart is its ability to learn faster,
adapt faster and make better decisions,
project after project. We do this by accelerating
intelligence: drawing on deep engineering
expertise, institutional knowledge, operational
insight, data and the capability of our
people to sharpen every decision across the
project lifecycle.

That intelligence is the enabler. The outcome
we pursue is excellence, relentless and
uncompromising, in how we execute, the
quality and safety we deliver, the productivity
we achieve, the sustainability we embed and
the value we create for every stakeholder.
It is the convergence of these two, intelligence
accelerated, excellence embraced, that is
shaping KEC’s evolution from a traditional
EPC contractor into a connected, agile and
knowledge-driven enterprise.

Anchored in this approach, our diversification
across businesses, geographies and clients
gives us a resilient and de-risked model and
the breadth to contribute meaningfully to
national development, the energy transition,
urbanisation and industrial growth.

Celebrating Excellence

                                             Cluster-Level Water Neutrality Certificate
                                                                                 KEC International Ltd
                                             This Water Neutrality Certificate is awarded to KEC International Limited in recognition of its achievement of Net
                                             Water Positive status across five operational locations — Vadodara, Jaipur, Jabalpur, Mysore, and Nagpur —
                                             through a cluster-level assessment. This accomplishment reflects the company’s steadfast commitment to
                                             responsible water stewardship and the successful implementation of replenishment initiatives across multiple
                                             sites, ensuring that the total water consumption is effectively offset through sustainable recharge measures during
                                             the assessment period from April 2024 to March 2025.

Address Global Priorities
In the process of managing our different capitals and the pursuit of creating value for our stakeholders, we
contribute significantly to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs). Our priorities for
sustainable development are aligned to those of India as well as of the global community. As a responsible
corporate citizen, we have mapped the contribution made by our capitals to the various UN SDGs.

                                   Note (d) General reserve is created from time to time by way of transfer of profits from retained earnings. General reserve is created by a transfer from one component of equity
                                            to another and is not an item of other comprehensive income.
                                   Note (e) Statutory reserve pertains to the Jointly Controlled Operation at Saudi Arabia. In accordance with the Saudi Arabian Companies law and the Articles of Association,
                                            10 % of the annual net income is required to be transferred to the Statutory Reserve until the reserve reaches 50 % of the capital of the Jointly Controlled Operation.
                                   Note (f) Retained earnings represents accumulated profit and remeasurement of defined benefit obligations as on reporting date. The reserve can be utilised in accordance with
                                            the provision of the Companies Act, 2013.
